'''Dwayne John "DJ" Bravo''' (born 7 October 1983) is a Trinidadian retired [[cricket]]er. After initially announcing his retirement from international cricket in October 2018, he came out of retirement in December 2019 in preparation for the [[2020 ICC Men's T20 World Cup|2020 T20 World Cup]].

In domestic cricket, Bravo has played for his native [[Trinidad and Tobago national cricket team|Trinidad and Tobago]] since 2002.

On 31 January 2015, Bravo announced his retirement from Test cricket.<ref>{{cite web|title=Bravo quits Tests}}</ref> In October 2018, he announced his retirement from international cricket in all formats but will continue to play franchise T20 cricket. In December 2019, Bravo came out of international retirement in preparation for the [[2020 ICC Men's T20 World Cup|2020 T20 World Cup]].
